title: Feature flag + tenant allowlist for SIEM audit export beta (kill switch + admin tooling)
author: Connor O'Brien
description:
Context: SIEM-ready audit export is entering limited beta and needs safe rollout controls at the tenant boundary. This PR adds (1) a hard kill switch, (2) a tenant allowlist gate, and (3) internal admin tooling to manage the allowlist without code deploys. The goal is to ensure we can enable a small cohort (hosted + dedicated) while maintaining strict tenant isolation and giving SRE a fast rollback lever during incidents.

What this changes: Adds feature flags under the `audit_export` namespace: `audit_export.enabled` (global kill switch, default=false) and `audit_export.beta_tenant_allowlist` (explicit allowlist of tenant IDs, default=empty). Both must evaluate true for a tenant to access audit export configuration APIs and for the exporter control-plane sync to serve configs for that tenant. Gating points: (a) Control plane: export config CRUD endpoints and status endpoints return `404` when the tenant is not enabled (to avoid feature discovery and reduce support confusion). (b) Exporter config feed: non-allowed tenants are filtered server-side to ensure exporter never receives configs for disabled tenants. (c) Console: UI endpoints use the same gating and show a generic "not available" empty state when gated.

Admin tooling: Adds an internal-only admin endpoint + CLI wrapper for manipulating the allowlist (add/remove/list) behind `internal:feature_flags:write` and `rbac:tenant_admin` checks. All allowlist mutations emit an audit event (`audit_export.rollout_allowlist.updated`) that includes actor, tenant_id, and diff (added/removed tenant ids) with PII-safe redaction rules.

Safety/operability: Adds a single kill switch that immediately blocks new config writes and stops serving configs to the exporter on next poll. Includes a small runbook snippet in the internal docs page referenced by SRE: expected propagation time (<60s), how to confirm gate status, and how to safely re-enable (stage: enable kill switch -> add tenant(s) -> verify exporter lag/health -> notify PM).

Testing: Unit tests for flag evaluation + authorization; integration tests for the control-plane endpoints returning 404 when gated; smoke test for exporter config feed filtering; and a minimal CLI e2e in CI (mock control plane).

Rollout plan: Land behind default-off flags. For beta accounts, we will enable `audit_export.enabled=true` and add tenant ids to allowlist via admin tooling. This PR does not change any defaults for existing tenants.

Notes / non-goals: This does not add Private/on-prem controls beyond flag plumbing; Private support remains out of scope for beta. No changes to delivery semantics (at-least-once) in exporter; this is strictly rollout gating.

Screenshots: N/A (backend + internal tooling only).

Follow-ups: (1) Wire the Console settings page to display the "request access" empty state (tracked separately). (2) Add a small metric on gated requests to help confirm accidental exposure (counter only; no tenant-id label).
commits: control-plane: introduce audit_export feature flag keys + evaluation helpers
control-plane: gate audit export config CRUD + status endpoints (404 when disabled)
exporter-feed: filter config stream by allowlist + kill switch
admin: internal endpoint + CLI wrapper for allowlist management
audit: emit rollout allowlist update event + add schema fixture
tests: add unit/integration coverage for gating + authZ
review_conversation: Ethan Park (review): Can we avoid returning 403 for gated tenants? I prefer 404 so this doesn’t become a feature discovery vector. Also please make sure the exporter feed is gated server-side, not just the UI.

Connor O'Brien (author): Agree. Switched all audit export routes to return 404 when gated. Also added feed-level filtering in config_feed.ts + tests to ensure disabled tenants never receive configs even if configs exist in storage.

Kaitlyn Nguyen (review): Admin endpoint needs tighter auth. Right now it checks internal auth but not RBAC. Require a specific permission to mutate allowlists; also make sure we don’t log raw tenant ids in app logs at INFO.

Connor O'Brien (author): Added `internal:feature_flags:write` requirement + RBAC `tenant_admin` check. Reduced logging to DEBUG with hashed tenant ids; INFO logs now only include counts. Allowlist mutations emit an audit event instead (diff + actor).

Sean Gallagher (review): From SRE perspective: propagation time? Also want a single kill switch that blocks exporter config serving (not just writes). Add a quick doc snippet for on-call so we know which flag to flip during an incident.

Connor O'Brien (author): Added global `audit_export.enabled` kill switch and wired it into both route gating and config feed. Added internal runbook doc with verification steps and expected propagation (<60s based on flag cache TTL).

Naomi Feldman (review): Please make sure the copy in the description doesn’t imply Private is included. Beta cohort is hosted + dedicated only. Also do we have an audit trail for allowlist changes for SOC2 evidence?

Connor O'Brien (author): Updated PR description + doc to explicitly call out Private as out-of-scope for beta. Added `audit_export.rollout_allowlist.updated` audit event emitted on allowlist mutations (actor + diff).
Benji Okafor (review): Minor: can we centralize the gating helper so routes and feed use the same function? Also ensure tests cover both flags must be true.
Connor O'Brien (author): Refactored into `services/audit_export/gating.ts` used by both. Added tests for all combinations (enabled=false, allowlist empty, tenant not present, both true).
Ethan Park (approval): LGTM after the 404 change + feed-level filtering. Thanks for adding the shared gating helper.
Kaitlyn Nguyen (approval): Approved with the tightened auth + reduced logging.
Sean Gallagher (approval): Approved. Doc is sufficient for beta; we’ll link from the runbook index in a follow-up.
